label: COMPONENT ABLATION OF J3M ONLY. No new algorithm family, no NNLS, no confidence gate, no CQT, no learned model, no visual test.
the_only_question: Did the large low-register gain observed in J3M come primarily from the fine multirate pitch front end, or from the CRP cepstral liftering?
why_it_matters: J3M changed two major things at once - a fine multirate pitch front end AND cepstral liftering. The envelope fixture showed the lifter does not do what was wanted on the synth problem; it says nothing about which stage produced the bass windfall. That determines whether the next branch stays on representation semantics / reliability / NNLS or reopens fine-frequency-resolution front ends.

preserved_unchanged_and_not_mutated.J3M: CRP_MOVEMENT_FAIL - the primary CRP hypothesis is dead. Canonical CRP(55) spectral-envelope suppression does not solve the synth/reed restraint residual. J3N does not revisit or soften that.

pipeline: the J3M faithful 88-band multirate elliptic pitch filterbank, unchanged
the same short-time pitch energies (128 ms window on the analysis hop grid)
THE_ONE_NEW_ARM.byte_identity_enforcement: both arms derive from ONE cached pitch-energy surface via one shared log_pitch() function. A control asserts that CRP recomputed from that cached surface equals the J3M cached CRP exactly.
THE_ONE_NEW_ARM.window: the exact 128 ms J3M PRIMARY pitch-energy surface. The question is attribution of the already-observed J3M result, so using another window would change two variables. NO window sweep. The published 200 ms sensitivity result already exists in the J3M receipt and is not repeated.

envelope_evolution_fixture.stimulus: the exact J3M constant-pitch brightness-sweep fixture, unchanged

what_it_separates.A: FB_LOG_CHROMA stable but CRP moves strongly -> the DCT/lifter itself introduces or amplifies sensitivity to fine partial evolution
what_it_separates.B: both move strongly -> the fine pitch-energy representation itself is sensitive to the brightness sweep; liftering is not the sole culprit

residual_family_diagnostic.secondary_question: does fine pitch resolution WITHOUT liftering unexpectedly help any of the actual weak families?
residual_family_diagnostic.if_a_large_signal_appears: return it to the PM. Do NOT promote it automatically.

NO_VISUAL_TEST.reason: this job is attribution, not candidate selection. CRP already failed visually. If FB_LOG unexpectedly shows a major restraint or information improvement in the weak families, the PM will separately authorise a visual probe.

compute_is_not_the_question: HOST analysis. No M85 cost estimation. The published pitch filterbank is NON-CAUSAL here because it retains zero-phase filtering; product feasibility is a later question.

outcomes.PITCH_FRONTEND_RESOLUTION_SIGNAL: FB_LOG retains most of the bass improvement seen in CRP while CRP adds little further benefit. Interpretation: J3M's bass windfall principally originates UPSTREAM of cepstral liftering, in the resolved pitch-energy representation.
outcomes.CRP_LIFTER_LOW_REGISTER_SIGNAL: FB_LOG remains near C3/P0 and the large bass gain appears only after CRP. This does NOT rehabilitate CRP for synth/reed - it would mean the same liftering that fails mechanism A carries useful low-register information.
outcomes.scope: this outcome is about the BASS / PITCH-RESOLUTION finding only. It does not change CRP_MOVEMENT_FAIL.

DISCLOSED_ANALYST_OPERATIONALISATION.status: the brief deliberately declines to set a fraction-recovered gate. 'Most' and 'near' still have to be decidable, so they are operationalised with the ALREADY-ESTABLISHED 0.10 materiality scale and no new number.
DISCLOSED_ANALYST_OPERATIONALISATION.retains_most: FB_LOG bass R-squared >= CRP bass R-squared - 0.10 AND >= C3 bass R-squared + 0.10
DISCLOSED_ANALYST_OPERATIONALISATION.remains_near_C3: FB_LOG bass R-squared < C3 bass R-squared + 0.10 while CRP >= C3 + 0.10
DISCLOSED_ANALYST_OPERATIONALISATION.reported_alongside: recall and false movement, so the mechanism reading is never R-squared-only

DO_NOT_EXECUTE: any mutation of the J3D/J3E/J3F/J3G/J3I/J3J/J3K/J3M receipts
then_stop: return to the PM. J3N decides whether J3M materially changes the ranking of the remaining representation hypotheses.
